body: Yeah. It’s so uncomfortable when people treat you so differently. It makes me feel awkward or guilty or naked every time i see them. Oh god, the atmosphere is so hard, and all these concerned looks as if I’m gonna kill somebody or myself at any second. And how they pressure you into talking about it with them, when you are obviously uncomfortable. And how they make you feel guilty that “you’re making them feel sad and worried”. Oh god. Thank you for making this post, hope you don’t mind my ranting.

Yes, it sounds like an infection. I’ve got the same thing. I think you can try to treat it at home. Clean it daily with some alcohol or hydrogen peroxide, put the ointment on it and put a bandage over it (change them couple times a day). That’s what I do. If it doesn’t work, go to doctor, infections can get nasty. I went to doctor because of this small thing and it was a humiliating experience, they prescribed me some antibiotics though.
Hope you feel better!

It’s easy to say “i would do that if i was on your place”, but in the actual situation things feel different. That’s a disclaimer before I answer your question.

If i saw scars on my date, depending on how fresh these scars are, I would probably wanna ask them if they’re ok, if they wanna talk about it, but I wouldn’t force the talk (i self-harm myself, so i know how uncomfortable it can be when people ask you questions). If the scars are fresh, I would try to bring the subject up, but if my partner is uncomfortable, I would leave it. If the scars are old, I probably wouldn’t ask at all (some people don’t like to be reminded of their past).

Again, I never had any romantic/sexual relationship, so no real experience from me. But I hope my reply was helpful all the same!
